blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No illegal items like guns and knives have been confiscated in Manila North Cemetery on the eve of Undas (All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day), according to the police. Police Major Philipp Ines, public information office chief of the Manila Police District, attributed this to the law enforment’s effective information dissemination. “As of now, we have not confiscated anything like that [illegal],” Ines said in an interview. “It only proves that our information dissemination has become effective,” he said. “We confiscated items that are not illegal per se.
